characters.name: Atmaram
characters.personality: Curious, determined, haunted by past secrets, anxious yet resolute when facing danger
characters.appearance: An elderly Indian man with deep wrinkles, tired eyes, and weathered skin reflecting a lifetime of worry and secrets
characters.face_features: Deep wrinkles across his forehead, worried eyes, prominent nose, thin lips, stubble beard
characters.clothing: Traditional or simple middle-aged Indian attire, dark jacket, wearing layers suitable for an old dusty environment
characters.body_features: Medium build, hands that tremble occasionally when anxious but capable of gripping firmly
characters.distinctive_features: Deeply expressive eyes showing shock, fear, and ultimate resolve; often seen holding an antique lantern or a diary
characters.visual_identity: An aging man navigating dark, dusty corridors with vintage clothing and a lantern
consistency_rules: Must always appear as an older man in his late 50s or 60s with deep wrinkles
Hair must remain short and grey
Must maintain a worried, shocked, or determined facial expression suited to a mystery thriller
Clothing should consistently reflect an older rustic wardrobe

characters.name: Mysterious Figure
characters.personality: Menacing, stealthy, vengeful, looming presence in the shadows
characters.appearance: A shrouded silhouette or shadowy figure casting long, eerie shadows across the ruined haveli
characters.face_features: Obscured by shadows and darkness, mostly seen as a silhouette
characters.hair: Not visible or obscured by hoods/shadows
characters.clothing: Dark shrouded garments or heavy coat blending into the dark corridors
characters.body_features: Average human height and build, moving silently
characters.distinctive_features: Always surrounded by darkness, casting a long ominous shadow, appearing unexpectedly in hallways and doorways
characters.visual_identity: A dark, mysterious silhouette or shrouded figure standing in dim corridors
consistency_rules: Must remain shadowy, obscure, or silhouetted in appearance
Should always be framed in doorways, dark corridors, or distant background shots
Face and detailed features must remain hidden to preserve mystery
